reviews.text: He has always been my little ShitZu Iki's vet and I am always satisfied with the care he provides.
Always very kind, attentive, and helpful. Both the veterinarians and the veterinary assistants. Thank you!

The receptionists were very kind, and the veterinarian, Mr. Antoniotti, was extremely competent and friendly.

I recommend them 1000%!

An incredible veterinary team, both in caring for our animals and for the owners. Attentive, offering sound advice, and providing excellent care… what more could you ask for?

A human-scale practice, a far cry from the impersonal, assembly-line approach of large clinics.
Thank you so much for taking such good care of my cat and for being so accommodating.
I would highly recommend them to everyone I know.

Hello,
I don't usually give compliments, but honestly, this is an excellent clinic, with doctors who know their stuff. They don't take advantage of owners' vulnerability around their animals. They provide good care, they are attentive to our animals, and know when to stop. As for the prices, there's nothing excessive there either. On the contrary, they show a lot of compassion and understanding. The same goes for the assistants who always greet us with a smile, offer advice, and are always ready to help. Far from feeling like a factory, it's almost like being part of a family.

I was seen by Dr. Favre and I have nothing but praise for his kindness, his attentiveness, and his very reassuring manner. He took great care to give my cat a treatment perfectly suited to his kidney condition. Highly recommended!

Dr. Favre is a very good veterinarian. We adopted a 3-month-old kitten, and he was very attentive and gave us excellent advice. He examined him thoroughly and closely monitored his mild case of feline herpesvirus. We returned for his booster vaccinations, and he handled our kitten very gently and carefully. I highly recommend him.

Incredible care! Our reactive dog has been treated here for almost a year. We've been in contact with two of the vets at the practice, and they're always wonderful. The rest of the staff is amazing too, always smiling and available. Thank you so much!
I have been coming here for several years and the welcome is always warm and friendly, the vets are all kind and attentive, I highly recommend!

The worst vets in the world refused to give me back my dog ​​and threatened to force me to pay 250 euros without invoices or reports. They called me from a blocked number to give me news about my elderly dog, who apparently had a heart condition and was dying. They paraded him around the waiting room, telling people, "Look at the sick dog, what a disgrace!" Then they forced me to see their colleagues for aggressive treatment and invasive procedures, justified only by the price. Suffering from multiple illnesses and, according to them, not having the right to end his life with dignity, I had to let him die, and God knows how much I would do for my animals... So today I changed vets, my companion is resting in peace, but I will never forget these despicable people.
A veterinarian who listens, is understanding, and compassionate. I highly recommend them.

Excellent team.
Always helpful and efficient.

Hello 😊
Thank you for your feedback! Your satisfaction and your pet's well-being are our top priorities, and your encouragement motivates us every day.

Sincerely,
The Mon Véto Marseille Fourragère Team
Very humane welcome, lovely and attentive vet.

Beatrice R.
I've known this veterinary clinic for years, and I recommend it whenever someone mentions a problem. I've entrusted them with the health of my four-legged friends for years. They are always kind and attentive. I've known the previous staff and the current team, and they're just as wonderful.
I've had my share of difficulties with my animals, and they've always done their utmost to treat and relieve their suffering. They've never left them in distress.
It's a fantastic team.
Thank you for everything.

I congratulate the team and the veterinarians who saved my dog ​​Gaston after he ate a processionary caterpillar.
The support, dedication, and professionalism shown by the entire team are unimaginable!
Thank you so much for everything!

Hello 🤗
Thank you so much for your 5 stars ✨
Best regards,
The Mon Véto Marseille Fourragère Team
We were very well received and the diagnosis seemed correct, or at least well explained.
Excellent team, skilled at handling animals (cats and dogs). Kind, attentive, and competent. A bit pricey, but that's typical of vets.

I am Loki, and today I am condemned. I've been monitored for a year for chronic gastritis, which, alas, doesn't exist! The medical team at the hospital let me die.
Today my mothers mourn me, and legal action will be taken! Run away, they are all incompetent! Goodbye, Loki.

My cat Judy was treated at this clinic for several years. The reception was always very pleasant, appointments and treatment were very quick. Dr. Antoniotti is very competent and always made the right decisions. The prices are affordable, and you can tell that the health and well-being of the animals is their top priority. I highly recommend this clinic.
Always a warm welcome, excellent advice, and a clear, patient approach. Thank you to the entire practice for your kindness and compassion. 🙏🏼🙏🏼 …

This week, I brought my dog ​​in as an absolute emergency as soon as the clinic opened in the morning, without an appointment. My dog ​​was in so much pain. The assistant was wonderful. Thank you again to her for getting my dog ​​settled so quickly in Dr. Antoniotti's office. He arrived practically at the same time, seeing how critical my little guy was.

Thank you, Dr. Antoniotti, for everything you did. You love your job and animals. You listened to people like me when I arrived with my dog ​​in my arms, desperate. Thank you to the Clinique de la Fourragère, all the assistants, and the veterinarians. You are all fantastic. I recommend this clinic 3000%! Your pets will be taken care of with the utmost care.

I'm giving my detailed opinion based on all the years I've taken my cat there. The reception area is always clean and welcoming, and all the staff are patient and helpful. The veterinarians are also wonderful (and I've seen many different ones); they are reassuring and competent. I will soon be doing my internship at this clinic, something I've dreamed of doing since childhood. I recommend it a thousand times over!
No one ever answers the phone!! What good is it to you???

I absolutely do NOT recommend this vet. I took my cat in because he had blood in his urine. The vet just palpated his bladder and told us our cat was in excellent health, then only gave us anti-inflammatories. Five days later, I found my cat dead at home. My daughter just lost her cat because of this vet's lack of professionalism. Not even a blood test or an ultrasound—it's shameful!

I called three times in a row; the automated message said my call was about to be answered, but the person clearly hung up each time.
It was 4:30 PM, maybe it was snack time.
So I called the Massilia clinic, who answered and made my appointment.
Veterinarians who truly love animals before money. A wonderful team, attentive and so caring!
Always very professional!

I absolutely do not recommend this clinic. I took my dog ​​there because he was having great difficulty walking, crying a lot, and eating much less. The vet barely examined him for five minutes before telling me he was healthy and simply suffering from arthritis. He gave him an injection, assuring me his condition would improve within a week. The result: my dog ​​continued to suffer terribly for a week… and sadly, he died. I am deeply shocked by the lack of professionalism and judgment during this consultation.

Terrible reception, appointment not noted, told me to come back...
This isn't the first time.

Furthermore! An emergency concerning one of my dogs.
Here's the assistant's response: "It can wait... it's not vital," while my dog ​​was howling in pain.
Since then, I've been avoiding this clinic.
Excellent team with a wonderful welcome, attentive service, and very good care.
Excellent emergency care. The staff were kind and understanding, and the treatment was good. The price was reasonable for a Saturday. Thank you very much to the team.
The veterinarian and assistants were attentive and the reception was reassuring. The care was quick and efficient. I recommend them!

Maximum charge every time… I hate being treated like a walking ATM, and that's clearly what it is here.

It's a shame, there's talent behind it, but you can really feel the desire to make as much money as possible.
These are truly wonderful vets with big hearts, both the doctors and the reception staff. I highly recommend this veterinarian.
I highly recommend them for their skills and friendliness.
Excellent team. Friendly and professional.

Highly professional. Extremely attentive. The team is fantastic, and the vets are super professional and reassuring.
We love them!
Top team, I highly recommend them
Friendly, welcoming and efficient staff
I recommend
Excellent team, conscientious and reassuring. Thank you!
Attentive and competent staff.
A clinic where I entrust my cat without hesitation.

A top-notch veterinary clinic with excellent staff, from veterinary assistants to veterinarians. Beyond their competence, regardless of the veterinarian, the staff are also very attentive to the owners. I personally cared for my dog ​​at home during his final days, and the assistants repeatedly offered advice and took the time to listen to me. I was lost and in so much pain... their advice helped and reassured me greatly. Beyond the care for our animals, the human interaction is exceptional. During the euthanasia, Dr. Gueydon was very attentive! Thank you to the entire team. This experience is important for beginning to grieve the loss of our companion with understanding, gentleness, and peace.
Warm welcome
